Comments

Density             : 100.00 %

The first eight items of jeu_100_100_1.txt, downloaded from
https://cedric.cnam.fr/~soutif/QKP/ -- the linear profits, the leading corner
of the quadratic triangle, the constraint type, the capacity and the weights
are the file's own numbers, unedited.  The capacity is the full instance's 616
and the eight weights sum to 139, so the trimmed instance is unconstrained;
what this fixture is for is the layout, not the packing.
